description: Your trading account as Fexr sees it: account value and margin, open positions with entry, mark, liquidation price, leverage and stop, your active Fexr strategies, and your plan and compute-unit balance. Read-only. Needs your signed-in Fexr account. Add include (any of profile, watch, lab, portfolio, persona) for how you trade (style, usual leverage and size, results by coin), the coins Fexr watches for you, your own patterns and fixes tested on past data, your portfolio's exposure, concentration and stop risk, and your persona: your trader groups and your real results by side, coin and leverage in dollars. fees gives your venue fee tier and what a fill costs on each market you hold. roles lists every role you hold (platform, workspaces, vaults); personalization says why Fexr orders things for you and what it showed you in the last 7 days.
name: get_my_account
title: Your Fexr account
